meta.note: Data are those of e1_equate.json and e4_neat_linear.json. equate: R equate's analytic standard errors (N - 1 moments in the equating function). equate_scaled: frequencies times 1e6, standard errors times 1e3. independent: delta method with finite-difference Jacobians, ddof = 0. equate_bootstrap: equate::bootstrap, for statistical comparison only.
